scope: Locked internal test evaluation of the previously selected refined-v2 pair. No threshold changed, checkpoint modified, training, or model selection performed.

triage_with_abstentions.interpretation: Selective metrics exclude abstentions; all-case counts are authoritative. Scores are uncalibrated research outputs.

evaluation_lock.selection: Refined-v2 selected and promoted using train/validation data before this evaluation. No test-based tuning or training is permitted.
evaluation_lock.prior_exposure: Original baseline had previously been tested. One CL test image was used solely for UI smoke tests. This is an internal evaluation, not a pristine external holdout.
evaluation_lock.evaluation_scope: Internal image-level test only. Patient identities and split separation are unverified; acquisition source is confounded with disease class. Not independent patient-level, external, or clinical validation.
